text:
An electricity meter records that 200MJ of electrical energy are drawn from the 240V mains
supply in a 24 hour period.
What is the average rate of electrical charge passing through the meter?
A
9.6C/h
B
580C/h
C
35kC/h
D
0.83MC/h
subject: Physics
